acceptanceScope: Independent static pure-owner and native-adapter review for the opt-in, nonpublished, no-base Business diagnostic-data probe. No open mandatory findings in this bounded slice.

closedFindings.finding: Native allocations returned into KeepData/KeepDataUnity could be lost if a post-allocation context check threw before retention.
closedFindings.resolution: Every nonnull returned wrapper is first retained in a managed pending list before context/pointer/Unity operations; successful ownership registration removes it, uncertain handles remain quarantined and block cleanup confirmation.

closedFindings.resolution: DATA mode finds the loaded GameAssembly module, rejects ambiguous/empty paths, and verifies its backing file and matching global-metadata.dat against the exact audited hashes before arming.

closedFindings.finding: SetProperty occurs in Prepare before the first normal ReadActiveState world pin; a generic valid Slot2 predicate was insufficient for the first mutation.
closedFindings.resolution: DATA Current closure binds the original Begin context canonical paths and SaveManager; first Capture pins world/generation/manager before Prepare. RequireContext rechecks these plus save queue idle. Pre-SetProperty boundaries also require inactive own root and zero own callback ledgers.

closedFindings.finding: A native return followed by context revocation could lose already-known SetProperty return or query scalar evidence.
closedFindings.resolution: SetPropertyReturned and invariant scalar/type receipts are recorded using managed state immediately after return, before the post-call context guard; readback confirmation follows successful fresh checks. Nonfinite failure values remain JSON-readable strings.
closedFindings.origin: Root independent review, relayed and checked by this reviewer

checks: Pure requireData requires network/data port; exact15 collection keys/counts and immutable copied snapshots with stable distinct IDs; four listener keys mandatory.
Pure query and retirement paths retain process-attempt/revocation semantics, fresh pre/post states, exact callbacks and additional data cleanup confirmation.

Eleven own empty IL2CPP lists, four arrays (one bounds element), two separately hidden loader fields, zero price/capacity and neutral flags are initialized/read back directly. No S1API setters with UI effects.
Two owned inactive helper GameObjects, their transforms, container and disabled unit-space BoxCollider are identity/parent/component/geometry checked. Root transform is also retained.

Native SetProperty, two native Business getters and S1API inside/outside route are method-token/signature/declaring-class/pointer/invoker pinned. Loader constructors match the bounded native audit. No original Business/FishNet Awake/Start/RPC/Register/Save calls added.
Both actual internal readonly S1API InnerBusiness and InnerProperty fields are read through exact declaring/type metadata and must point to own Business.
Each query substep revalidates current world/data/network/known holders/listeners before and after native call; wrong scalar results stop before subsequent queries.

Four listener groups include TimeManager ActionList object/list and ordered delegate graph, onTimeSkip, MoneyManager networth, Property acquisition, Business operation-start/finish; null delegates are distinguishable from unreadable wrappers; bounded graph cycles/overflow fail closed.
SetActive/deactivation/Destroy require fresh matching own data and foreign snapshots; Unity-owned helper/root/component absence is checked after Destroy while context remains current.

Only confirmed GC handles/wrapper references are released. Reports explicitly deny immediate native GC memory reclamation; cached report generation performs no fresh native observation after revocation.
Opt-in Data flag is isolated from other probe modes; normal mode remains unaffected by DATA-preprocessor sections.

limits: Static source/binary review and parent-attributed build/tests do not prove the new native query path ran in-game.
Empty laundering data and zero capacity test dispatch/dependency behavior only; they do not prove positive-balance aggregation, product balancing or gameplay money laundering.

Diagnostic box samples do not establish actual TownHall boundary calibration, purchase, initialized native Business/FishNet operation, spawn, persistence/reload or save safety for future writing code.
Native getter may initialize metadata and cached LINQ selector delegate; this is not a claim of zero global effects.

GC object handle release is not immediate native-memory reclamation.
Reviewer performed no production/test edits, builds, deployment, game actions or save-file access.
